name: DT.BETEILIG.AG  NA O.N.
summary: Deutsche Beteiligungs AG (DBAG) is a distinguished private equity firm employing direct investment and fund-of-funds strategies, providing capital for management buyouts, buy-ins, and growth financing primarily within the German Mittelstand and DACH region. Established in 1965, it is headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, Germany.
